Solution :19  
44 + 13 = 57  
57 + 24 = 81 (first increment +13)  
81 + 37 = 118 (second increment +13)  
118 + 50 = 168 (followed by +13)  
168 + 63 = 231 (followed by +13)  
231 + 76 = 307 (followed by +13)  
This corrected increment sequence yields a new series: 44, 57, 81, 118, 168, 231, 307  
Looking back at our original series:
